g.title: dbml
g.text: Crow’s Foot: circle = 0; bar = 1; fork = N. Solid = identifying; dashed = non-identifying. PK / FK / UQn = key labels; (!) = NOT NULL.

g.title: classes
g.text: Completion actor may be NULL for system completion.

g.title: bookings
g.text: At most 1 full release operation per Booking.

g.title: wallets
g.text: User has 0..1 Wallet; system Wallet has no User.

g.title: ledger_transactions
g.text: Unposted: 0..N postings; posted/reversed: at least 2, sum = 0.
Full reversal: exactly 1 original; original has 0..1 full reversal.
Original ID is NULL for every other transaction kind.

g.title: withdrawal_requests
g.text: Every saved request has a posted hold (at least 1 transaction).
